name: Chanarach
title: Herald of Flames
summary: The patron of the Dustbringers. One of the more mysterious Heralds, theorized to have been the mother of a notable Cosmere figure. Her current whereabouts remain unknown, and her role in the Oathpact is shrouded in speculation.
honorbladeGrants: Division and Abrasion — the power to break bonds and to alter the friction of surfaces.
quote: "Destruction is not the opposite of creation — it is the prelude."
